ios.requires: System and media hold are supported for the participating call.

android.requires: Telecom and media hold are supported for the participating call without implying remote answer.

ios.requires: An app or service request can negotiate and confirm video with the registered media provider. Capture also needs permission.

android.requires: An app or service request can negotiate and confirm video with the registered media provider. Capture also needs permission.
The profile qualifies app or service video changes through media negotiation, permissions and observed system type.

ios.requires: A registered media or signaling provider can send tones for the call.

android.requires: A registered media or signaling provider can send tones for the call. Telecom supplies call control.

ios.requires: Native preview presentation and policy permit following the call without ringing or audio.
Policy permits native prejoin and a registered provider can prepare while keeping capture and output closed.

android.requires: Policy permits native prejoin and a registered provider can prepare while keeping capture and output closed.

ios.requires: A bounded native authority is installed before incoming intake, with validated budget and any required credentials.

android.requires: A bounded native authority is installed before incoming intake, with validated budget and any required credentials.

ios.requires: The system audio adapter can observe routes and apply route intent within the active session.

android.requires: The Telecom adapter observes endpoints and supports changes for the current call. Endpoint absence or unreadiness can limit an individual route.

ios.requires: The native PushKit adapter and VoIP registration are configured for the app.

android.requires: The native FCM intake and registration adapter are configured, including forwarding when using an existing service.

ios.requires: Native descriptors are installed for SDK-owned notifications or previews.

android.requires: Native descriptors are installed for SDK-owned call notifications and respect system action requirements.
The Android full-screen notification intent is configured and currently allowed for the app and call.
The profile qualifies system-initiated video upgrades, including observed system type and confirmed media application.
The profile qualifies system-initiated video downgrades, including observed system type and confirmed media application.

ios.requires: The system supplies Focus filtering evidence for the call.
ActivityKit preview support is available and enabled on the device.
The app has opted into a supported system dial path and can assign a canonical call ID.
